description: Create and manage MIND-native automations — scheduled or event-triggered rules that run without a human or agent invoking them each time (e.g. a weekly CRM digest, a webhook that logs an event to a life project). This is for recurring MIND-internal work, not a general task scheduler for external systems. Actions: list/create/update/delete, run_now (fire immediately for testing), history (execution log). `trigger_config`/`action_config` are JSON strings, not objects — pass valid JSON or the call throws. An empty list means no automations are configured in this account yet, not that scheduled work isn't happening elsewhere.

action.description: Action: list/create/update/delete automations, run_now (trigger immediately), history (execution log)

action_config.description: JSON config string for the action

action_type.description: Action type to execute when triggered

trigger_config.description: JSON config string for the trigger (e.g. cron expression, event name)

name: mind_automate
